editorial:
Set against the gorgeous backdrop of the 1920s French Riviera, this charming romantic comedy follows Stanley, a famous magician who makes his living exposing fake psychics. When a wealthy friend asks him to investigate a young American woman named Sophie who claims to have real psychic powers, Stanley arrives fully confident he can debunk her. But Sophie is charming, quick-witted, and surprisingly hard to crack, and as the two spend time together, Stanley finds his cold skepticism slowly melting into something warmer. The movie has a light, breezy feel with beautiful scenery and witty banter that keeps things moving.

Colin Firth and Emma Stone carry the film with great chemistry, and the period costumes and locations look lovely. The pacing is gentle rather than fast, so if you want big laughs or action, this might feel slow. Still, the dialogue is sharp and the romance builds naturally. It is a great pick for a cozy night in, especially if you enjoy classic-style romantic comedies. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Stanley's beloved aunt passes away, and Sophie somehow knows private details about her that she could not possibly have learned. This shakes Stanley's lifelong disbelief in the supernatural, and he proposes to Sophie. The movie ends with the two of them together, leaving you wondering whether Sophie truly has powers or whether it was all just clever trickery. It is a sweet, open-ended conclusion that fits the film's playful tone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic romantic comedies and beautiful period settings.
